_comment: Third-party packs the starter-pack skills route to. These are NOT redistributed here — the installer prints these commands and you run them, so the code keeps coming from its author. Every source below was verified against a live upstream; a pack whose upstream could not be verified is listed under _unbundled instead of being shipped with a guessed URL.

gstack.why: The Think -> Plan -> Build -> Review -> Test -> Ship -> Reflect toolchain that gtan-workflow routes to. 23 commands: /office-hours, /autoplan, /review, /qa, /ship, /land-and-deploy and the rest.
gstack.author: Garry Tan
gstack.note: The setup script registers the commands and builds a browser binary, so it takes a few minutes and wants network access.

superpowers.why: Test-driven development, systematic-debugging, brainstorming and verification-before-completion. build-tdd chains its TDD and completion-gate skills.
superpowers.author: obra

ui-ux-pro-max.why: The design-intelligence engine design-router treats as the primary for all non-branded UI: palettes, styles, font pairings, chart palettes and stack best-practices behind a BM25 search. pro-max-search documents how to drive it.
ui-ux-pro-max.author: nextlevelbuilder

stop-slop.why: The primary anti-slop pass on the writing-router's anti-slop axis: the five-dimension rubric over openers, jargon, contrasts, passive voice and specificity.
stop-slop.author: Hardik Pandya

anti-ai-slop-writing.why: Used by writing-router as the banned-word dictionary and punctuation ratios only, not as a second full workflow alongside stop-slop.
anti-ai-slop-writing.author: jalaalrd

plain-writing.why: The plain-word end of the writing-router's clarity axis: everyday words, no jargon, plus a revision view of what it changed.
plain-writing.author: Shreya Shankar

ponytail.why: The minimal-code discipline build-tdd builds under: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.
ponytail.author: DietrichGebert

_unbundled.writing-clearly-and-concisely: Strunk's Elements of Style (1918) as a reference skill. The 1918 text is public domain; the skill wrapper's upstream could not be verified, so no source is claimed here. Any Elements of Style reference skill satisfies the writing-router's Strunk slot.
